title: Northgate Tire Center Price Schedule: Installation Package, Sensor Kit and Disposal Fees
content:
# Northgate Tire Center — Installation Package Price Schedule

Each Northgate Tire Center installation package is priced per tire installed. Two further per-tire fees are set by the package: the fee for the sensor service kit on each wheel equipped with a tire pressure monitoring (TPMS) sensor, and the fee for disposing of each old tire removed. A fee shown as $0.00 means that item is included in the package and nothing is charged for it.

## Schedule (USD, per tire)

| Package | Package price per tire installed | TPMS sensor service kit fee per equipped wheel | Old tire disposal fee per tire |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Tire Mount & Balance | 15.00 | 6.99 | 3.00 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package | 21.99 | 4.99 | 3.00 |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package | 27.99 | 4.99 | 3.00 |
| Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | 31.99 | 0.00 (included) | 3.00 |
| Northgate Premium Tire Care | 39.99 | 0.00 (included) | 0.00 (included) |
| Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard | 41.99 | 4.99 | 3.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The package price is a price **per tire installed**, not per set.
- The TPMS sensor service kit fee is a fee **per wheel that carries a pressure sensor**; a wheel without a sensor takes no kit.
- The disposal fee is a fee **per old tire removed**.
- A $0.00 entry is an inclusion, not a missing price: on the Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard and on Northgate Premium Tire Care the sensor service kit is included, and on Northgate Premium Tire Care old-tire disposal is included as well.

## Points of comparison

- Northgate Premium Tire Care is the only package with both the sensor kit and disposal included.
- The two light truck packages share the same sensor kit and disposal fees ($4.99 and $3.00) and differ in the package price per tire ($27.99 and $41.99).
- Northgate Tire Mount & Balance carries the lowest package price per tire ($15.00) and the highest sensor kit fee ($6.99).
